images.exact_prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational, photorealistic rehabilitation exercise photograph.
Asset type: single independent step photograph for T-AXU-051 wall angel, s01 LOW START position.
Input images 1, 2, 3 are visual identity and photographic style references only. Preserve this exact adult East Asian woman: face, age, natural skin texture, normal slim adult proportions, dark ponytail, fitted plain white short-sleeved crew-neck T-shirt and dark charcoal full-length fitted athletic trousers. Repose her as specified; reference arm positions are not the exercise instruction.
Scene: a plain smooth cool light gray-blue studio wall with a matching gray-blue floor and subtle visible wall-floor boundary, matching the references' background hue and soft neutral diffused studio lighting. No other objects. Unbranded low-profile white athletic shoes.
One woman in ONE pose, ONE photograph, portrait 4:5 composition. Full body, entire head, both hands and both feet visible with comfortable margins. Camera fixed straight frontal at torso height, natural 70 mm perspective, no wide-angle distortion.
Exact pose: she faces the camera with her upper back lightly supported by the wall. Feet hip-width apart, flat and comfortably a little forward of the wall, knees soft, stable upright torso. Natural small lumbar gap is allowed; do not force head or lower back flat to wall. Her arms are at the LOW START of a gentle wall angel: both upper arms open symmetrically only about 35 to 40 degrees away from her sides, elbows bent approximately 90 degrees; elbows clearly BELOW shoulder level, near lower ribs, and hands near shoulder level. Forearms point diagonally up and slightly outward, forming a relaxed LOW W shape. Palms face forward, fingers naturally relaxed and anatomically correct; arms lie close to the wall without forced wrist contact. Shoulders relaxed and level, not shrugged. Neutral comfortable head and neck, gaze toward camera, calm expression. Ribs stay down and torso stable, no lumbar arch or exaggerated chest lift.
Constraints: natural adult head-to-body and limb ratios, continuous anatomically correct joints, exactly two arms and two legs, five fingers on each hand. Visible support relation to wall, shoes on floor. No text, letters, labels, step numbers, arrows, symbols, logos, watermark, inset, collage, duplicate pose or ghost limbs. This is a low starting pose, not overhead or shoulder-level goalpost.

visual_review.pose: 正面全身；上背轻靠灰蓝墙；双脚踩地位于墙前，双肘低于肩、双肘弯曲，双手位于肩附近构成低W；肩放松，头颈中立，躯干无明显仰腰。
visual_review.identity_style: 女性白色短袖、深灰长裤、黑色马尾、白鞋、灰蓝棚拍与参考一致；两张面部、服装、光线一致。
visual_review.anatomy: 成人头身及四肢比例自然，双臂双腿完整，手指关节连接无明显异常，完整头手脚可见。
visual_review.content: 一人一姿势，无图内文字、编号、箭头、拼图或水印。
visual_review.limits: 正面照片可见靠墙关系，但不能直接量化腰部间隙、肌肉发力或受力。

images.exact_prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational, identity-preserve photographic pose edit.
Asset type: single independent step photograph for T-AXU-051 wall angel, s02 COMFORTABLE UPWARD END position.
Input image 1 is the approved s01 wall-angel starting photograph and the edit target. Input images 2, 3, 4 are the original visual identity/style references for the same adult East Asian woman.
Primary request: make ONE independent full-body photograph of this SAME woman at the comfortable upward endpoint of a wall angel, by changing ONLY her two arms from the low starting pose to a symmetrically higher pose.
Keep exactly unchanged: her facial identity and calm expression, black ponytail, white short-sleeve crew-neck T-shirt, charcoal fitted full-length trousers, white athletic shoes, natural body proportions, neutral head/neck, torso and pelvis, leg and foot positions, feet flat and a little forward of wall, upper back light wall support, gray-blue wall and floor, the wall-floor boundary, soft neutral studio light and shadow, camera position and focal perspective, portrait 4:5 frame, full-body scale and framing. Keep both entire hands and feet visible. Do not re-center, crop or change her stance.
Exact new arm pose: both arms have slid UP along a comfortable symmetric wall-angel route. Raise both elbows from low ribs to just slightly ABOVE shoulder height, upper arms approximately 100 to 110 degrees from the torso. Each elbow remains comfortably bent approximately 85 to 100 degrees. Both forearms point diagonally upward; hands now above crown level, forming a relaxed symmetrical high W shape. Palms face camera, wrists neutral, natural fingers. Arms lie close to the wall but do not force the hand backs to touch. This is a modest comfortable endpoint, not maximally straight overhead arms. Hands and elbows substantially higher than input image 1.
Shoulders remain relaxed and level without shrugging; torso upright with no back arch, no rib flare, no chest lift, no head tilt. Do not force head or lower back onto wall. Preserve exactly two arms and two legs with continuous natural joints and five-finger hands.
No text, labels, numbers, arrows, logos, watermark, inset, collage, motion trail, duplicate pose, ghost limbs or extra objects. One posture in one photograph.
